race.comment: PRECISE STAR (3) made a winning Queensland debut for Tony Gollan when edging out her rivals in a thrilling Sunshine Coast finish last start and, despite a rise in the weights, he looks capable of taking the next step immediately, even from a nasty gate. ATLANTIC COAST (5) has been building nicely this prep, and he looks ready to peak after a solid third over 1350m at Ipswich 16 days ago. Stick with him on an each-way basis. CRITICAL TIME (13) rediscovered winning form with a soft win in lesser company at Grafton last start. He is normally consistent when fit, and he is worth including in all combos. MONTE CARLO MISS (15) was  an emphatic maiden winner 3 starts back in a questionable field at Casino, but her next 2 starts have also been full of merit. Don't risk her.
